title: Endless Summer | KEY.co
description_expanded: Outdoor living is woven throughout the property, with covered balconies providing peaceful spaces to unwind and a top-floor entertainment area featuring a sundeck and fire pit, perfect for enjoying coastal breezes under the evening sky. A private resort-style pool offers a refreshing retreat, while the game room adds another layer of entertainment for guests of all ages. With a private elevator for easy access between floors and complimentary bicycles and a golf cart for exploring the surrounding area, this thoughtfully curated home blends modern comfort, convenience, and coastal charm just a short walk from the beach. This newly constructed four-level coastal retreat offers an elevated setting for memorable gatherings along 30A. Thoughtfully designed with generous living spaces and seven well-appointed bedrooms, the home comfortably accommodates large groups and extended families while maintaining a sense of relaxed luxury. Multiple living areas encourage both connection and quiet moments, while beverage stations on every level and a chef-inspired kitchen make entertaining effortless. The main living space is anchored by a gas fireplace, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere after days spent along the nearby shoreline.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
